articles.title: Mass Protests in Prague: Why Are Tens of Thousands Taking to the Streets?
articles.description: Tens of thousands of Czechs rallied in Prague against a government plan to scrap the public media fee and fund broadcasters from the state budget. Critics say it would threaten the independence of Czech television and radio, while Prime Minister Andrej Babis says it eases the burden on households.

articles.title: Tonga marks 20-year anniversary of Nuku'alofa pro-democracy riots
articles.description: Twenty years after deadly pro-democracy riots rocked Tonga, the country is still trying to navigate the delicate balance between monarchy and democracy.

articles.title: New Protests Following Riots at a Housing Demonstration in Spain
articles.description: Hundreds of people in Barcelona have called for the release of four individuals who were arrested Wednesday evening following clashes on the fringes of protests against the housing crisis.
